_about: Visual review of the image DABS attaches to each CSC (inline on its public detail page). Three separate judgments are kept: attached_to_csc (provenance, always true here), exact_depiction (visual evidence that the picture shows the listed item, including size), rights (never established by DABS hosting). visual: matches | family | conflict. size_evidence: label = volume legible in the picture; shape = unambiguous form (1.75 L PET/handle bottle, 375 ml flask, 12 vs 16 oz can, printed box volume); none; conflict. vintage (wine): legible year, illegible, nv, or n/a.
reviewer: Claude (single reviewer), 2026-09-29, contact sheets at 350 px plus zooms
